newsitem.title: FRANCE: French industry minister still wants Thomson sale.
newsitem.headline: French industry minister still wants Thomson sale.

text.p: French Industry Minister Franck Borotra said in a statement that he still wanted a privatisation of Thomson SA after the government decided to suspend the procedure on advice from the Privatisaion Commission.
"The goal of privatisation of Thomson, and in particular TMM (Thomson Multimedia), remains essential for the future of the company," Borotra said.
"TMM needs to cuts its debt, enter new markets and improve its competitiveness in order to better exploit its technological and human resources," he added.
"Only a privatisation can give it the necessary means to reach its ambitious development aims," he said.
"The government will soon announce the terms for a restart of the privatisation process," he said.
